comment: ZAP alerts reviewed in P7 (docs/reports/P7-exit-review.md). Only High-risk alerts fail scripts/dast.py; Medium ones are listed here with the reason they are accepted.

accepted.reason: All mutations are Next.js Server Actions (POST) protected by the framework's Origin/Host check plus SameSite=Strict HttpOnly session cookies (ADR-0017, threat model T3, SEC-WEB-03). There are no cookie-authenticated GET mutations.

Inline style attributes are needed by React style props and the charts. Scripts are nonce-only with 'strict-dynamic' (no unsafe-inline), so injected markup cannot execute code; styles alone cannot exfiltrate the HttpOnly session.
